description: showThemePackSelect reads its sixth column word ([esp+0x32], movsx at 0x00472e59) for flag bit 5 of each row but never writes it (the five written words are stored at 0x004725cf..0x004725eb), so the current theme's row gets one more cell (A[4] plain, A[5] with the bit set) at x = w - 0x2b, and a non-current row with bit 5 (the *.cse probe) one A[6] cell there. In cov_r_s2_screens the four runs without the trace recorder (det_a, det_b, det_c, c_a) show the cell at x -17, so w = 0x1a there (2,170 px of yellow over x 0..69, y 156..186 of the Standard row); the recorder's runs t_rec / t_rep1 show none (the port with no cell, or with w = -0x3334, the debug fill as a signed word, equals both in every pixel). Which code writes that stack word before the screen's frame is allocated, and whether a run without Frida holds 0x1a there, is not measured. The port's backend uses w = 0x1a (SG_GFX_THEMEPACK_COL5 overrides it: a number or `none`)
needed: a stack probe at the screen's entry in a game run (the word at entry esp - 0x14 - frame + 0x32, with and without the trace recorder), or the lead's decision on the port's default (0x1a = the pinned runs' frame; `none` = the trace runs' frame)

description: loadFlic runs waitTicks(10, 0) on every 100th load (0x0043d788, reached also when g_difficulty is not -1, jne 0x0043d766), but the port's load_flic consumes that wait's clock reads from the trace only on the boot path (g_difficulty == -1, where it also draws the loading screen and refreshFull). A checkpoint inside a session's loadFlic wait would be snapshotted at the next consumed trace item instead
needed: a checkpoint taken inside a session's 100th-load wait (loadFlic during a course switch), or a generic waitTicks clock model in tick.cpp

description: Pick A Pro's card (a selected pro: sel != -1) is drawn by the port's pick_a_pro_screen but no checkpoint shows it: the portrait is the Surface g_sprites5628e8 + 0x2c + 0x84 (c + 72 t) (c the signed byte +0x22 of g_golferTypes, t = 1 when bit 7 of +0x21 is clear), which the backend has no sprite for until the golfer sprite sheets are modelled (S3), so the card's Image_draw would read `Image_draw: a SpriteRef the backend has no sprite for`; the quote (drawTextSurface), signature and the ten skill rows are not judged on a frame
needed: a checkpoint after a click on a pro row (cov_r_s2_screens has the list with nothing selected), and the golfer portrait sheet in the backend
